_comment: Hand-written input of `cargo xtask attributions`, which merges it with docs/PORTS.md, li-seg's MODELS, SAM 3, the li-ai family profiles and Cargo.lock into assets/attributions.json (the file the app shows in Settings / Preferences / About › Attributions). Edit this file for assets, data and projects that have no machine-readable source; never edit assets/attributions.json by hand. Sections appear in this order; generated entries come before the ones listed here. licence_files are paths from the repository root and are built into the app.

app.name: Local Image
app.used_for: A layered raster editor, photo library and raw developer with local AI, written in Rust.

sections.title: Algorithms & code ports

entries.name: FBCNN · JPEG cleanup
entries.used_for: FBCNN · JPEG cleanup at original resolution; applies on a new layer. Automatic quality-factor prediction; the core node has no quality-factor input.

entries.name: SCUNet-real · Scan cleanup
entries.used_for: SCUNet-real · Scan cleanup at original resolution; applies on a new layer. PSNR-trained real-image cleanup; no GAN weights.

entries.name: NAFNet-SIDD · Denoise
entries.used_for: NAFNet-SIDD · Denoise at original resolution; applies on a new layer. SIDD real smartphone denoising, width 64.

entries.name: DDColor · Colourise
entries.used_for: Apache-2.0 relicensed Hugging Face tiny weights only, pinned revision e9e7b527709c8aeb2f5e1bf701e72fd468a13baa. Verified FP32 ONNX export runs on-device in Rust through tract; original Lab luminance and alpha are preserved.

entries.name: Microsoft scratch detector · Repair old photo
entries.used_for: MIT one-channel UNet from the official v1.0 release; verified FP32 ONNX export. Scratch mask reviewed in AI Remove before filling; optional DDColor preview after a successful repair. No dlib or face stage.

entries.name: Local Image approved Glossy Duotone artwork and source adaptations
entries.author: Local Image contributors
entries.used_for: Owner-approved Glossy Duotone base: 88 original glyphs retained exactly. Six reviewed replacements (Crop, Brush, Gradient, Eraser, Ellipse and Rectangle Marquee) use pinned upstream geometry with filled family/metal gradients, dark outlines and highlights. Colour/mono SVGs and review sheets; selection in assets/icons/SOURCES.md.
